items.title: NetApp (NTAP) Stock Looks Near Fair Value While Earnings Trade At A Premium
items.summary: After a strong multi year run, NetApp now trades at a level where the share price and the intrinsic value estimate tell a similar story. At the same time, the broader valuation checks still suggest the stock is not an obvious bargain. NetApp has returned 176.2% over the past 5 years, which puts extra focus on whether current expectations are already fully reflected in the share price.
